frequency_question: How often do central bank principals successfully execute a benchmark interest rate hike when they signal intent and possess the statutory capability over a rolling multi-quarter window?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign central banks with independent monetary policy mandates; excludes fixed-exchange-rate boards without rate-setting discretion and periods of external occupation or statutory suspension.
window: Rolling 12-month policy evaluation windows between 2000 and 2026.

cases.name: RBI Rate Hike Cycle (Shaktikanta Das leadership, 2022)
RBI Rate Hike Cycle (Raghuram Rajan leadership, 2013)
Banco Central do Brasil Rate Hike Cycle (2021)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named emerging market tightening episodes; represents core instances of discretionary tightening under explicit principal intent.
known_gaps: Does not exhaust all minor rate adjustments globally, but captures primary comparable central bank actions.
skeleton: 6 historical emerging market tightening episodes where statutory authority and explicit leadership intent aligned.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 relevant comparable instances where intent and capability were both present.
validity_reason: Central bank statutory authorities and the mechanics of discretionary monetary tightening remain stable across multi-year horizons.
